audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-4 read Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Ziggs against the packet chart's Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Kayle — and against the page's own whys, which say level 2 is still 'soak XP and survive', levels 3 and 4-5 are 'even attrition' and 'closer to neutral', and level 6 is where Kayle owns the lane.
audit.why: Kayle cannot contest an 850-range bomb while melee; she only answers it once Divine Ascent goes ranged at 6.
audit.corrected: Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle — matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Ziggs levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Kayle late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge was described only as 'his knockback + self-peel escape' with no cooldown or range, Hexplosive Minefield had no number, and Bouncing Bomb's range — the reason the early lane is unplayable — was never given.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s at 1000 range and displaces both of you, so the 20s after he spends it is the entire engage window. Hexplosive Minefield is a FLAT 16s at every rank, which makes it a reliable bait target. Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850 range against Kayle's 550-range E and melee autos.
audit.corrected: All three numbers now in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] was titled 'Waste R on chip damage' with boilerplate underneath that never gave the cost of doing so.
audit.why: Kayle's R is 160s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown either champion holds — so spending it on anything but blanking his burst leaves nearly three minutes uncovered.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Ziggs's Satchel Charge is down.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb is 4-6s at 850 range and you are still melee — soak XP and give the CS you cannot reach.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ziggs must walk into your range.
edits.after: Q shred and W healing stabilize you a little, but his bomb poke still wins the extended trade. Even attrition.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Satchel Charge's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Closer to neutral as W heal and Q's resist shred come online, but his 850 range still beats yours — play for 6 and dodge the mines.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ziggs's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R blanks an E-into-Q burst — you finally answer the poke. Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, so punish after it.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Satchel Charge's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health on-hit out-pressure his bombs — bait the 16s minefield, then close.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Ziggs carry threat 7.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: At two items your full-AoE autos and E's shred melt an immobile artillery mage whose only escape is one Satchel hop.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, 1000 range; it knocks you back and hops him out. Engage after it. - Hexplosive Minefield: a flat 16s wall of slows. - Bouncing Bomb: 6s at rank 1, 850 range.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 20s at rank 1 from 1000 range — it knocks you back and hops him out, so engage after it.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s — bait the mines, then close.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: R is 160s at rank 1 — spend it to blank his burst, nothing less.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Scale, then E-melt with R cover.
edits.after: Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 1000 range — knocks you back and hops him out. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s wall of slows.

notes: All three packet suspect names are FALSE POSITIVES — 'His Bouncing Bomb', 'Bouncing Bombs' and 'Stack Hexplosive Minefield' are the real ability names with ordinary English words attached. The kit file tags Satchel Charge with a percentHealth flag, but Riot's own description says only 'deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' with no max-health component; per the rule to trust the description over a misfiring derived flag, I did NOT write any percent-health claim for Satchel Charge, and the missingInteractions 'resistances-invalidated' headline that depends on that same flag looks unreliable here. Hexplosive Minefield being a flat 16s at all ranks (not a per-rank ramp) is worth keeping in the text — it makes the bait timing exact.
